settings.ratings_help: Members can give one to five stars overall, and rate each aspect below. Turn this off for words only.
settings.anonymous_help: Members can choose to show no name at all. Moderators always see who wrote it.
settings.depot_source_help: Depot reviews rated 4 stars or more, with words in them, show as testimonials about their download. Depot never asked reviewers for consent, so these show on the forum only and are never marked OK to feature outside it. A review edited below 4 stars or deleted is taken down at once, and reviewers can hide theirs from the widgets in their profile.
settings.min_posts_help: 0 lets any member with permission write one. Moderators are never held back.
settings.min_days: Days since joining before writing one
settings.min_trust_level: Trust level needed before writing one
settings.widget_min_rating: Widgets show testimonials rated at least
settings.widget_min_rating_help: Stars, 0 to 5. The Testimonials page always lists them all. 0 shows everything in the widgets too.
settings.stock_top: Carousel at the top of the discussion list
settings.stock_help: For forums without Bespoke, Page Builder or FoF Widgets. Each one steps aside while one of those hosts shows the same widget.
settings.nudge: Ask active members to write one
settings.nudge_help: A small card at the top of the discussion list for members who have posted and stayed a while and haven't written one yet. They can close it.

aspects.label: Rated aspects
aspects.help: Besides the overall stars, members can rate each of these. Each one is optional on the form. Renaming one keeps its ratings; removing one hides it and keeps its ratings.
